title: MultibandGate — per-band gain targets, smoothing, controls
description:
Implement Source/DSP/MultibandGate to apply per-band target gains with independent open/close smoothing and recombine bands to a single output, consuming CrossoverSplitter-style band buffers.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md sections 15–16 (gate/expansion laws, floor, curve shape, per-band open/close smoothing, y[n]=sum G_b * x_b)
- Source/DSP/CrossoverSplitter.* public band-buffer / mode API from f.1
- Existing Source/DSP/GainSmoother.* or gate gain units from earlier phases for polish consistency
- Source/ParameterIDs.h for per-band threshold/floor/attack/hold/release/mute/solo IDs if present

Implement MultibandGate.h/.cpp per §15–16:
- Support 1 (full), 2 (dual), or 3 (tri) active bands. Internally hold G_b and G_b* linear gains per band.
- Target gain path: accept external per-band target gains G_b*[n] (linear) set each block/sample from dialed thresholds OR expose setBandTargetGain / processTargets from control-rate log-energy + threshold + floor + curve. Minimum control surface:
  - per-band floor G_floor (dB mapped via g_floor = 10^(G_floor_dB/20), range 0 dB through −80 dB)
  - optional per-band mute (force floor/near-zero) and solo (other bands muted)
  - curve shape g_shaped = g_floor + (1-g_floor) * S^gamma with gamma control (Natural/Firm/Clamp)
  - soft vs hard gate kneewish behavior may remain simplified if full §15 laws are deferred to shared detector — document assumptions; core required behavior is target + smoothing + combine.
- Per-band smoothing (§16):
  alpha_b = exp(-1/(fs * tau_open_b)) when G_b* > G_b
  alpha_b = exp(-1/(fs * tau_close_b)) when G_b* <= G_b
  G_b[n] = alpha_b * G_b[n-1] + (1-alpha_b) * G_b*[n]
  Separate tau_open_b / tau_close_b (and optional per-band offsets/multipliers) settable per band.
- Output: y[n] = sum_b G_b[n] * x_b[n] written to a mono/stereo output buffer. Apply gains sample-wise; no zipper on floor/threshold parameter moves beyond caring about G_b smoothing.
- Integration with CrossoverSplitter: either take externally split band buffers + write sum, or optionally own a CrossoverSplitter member used only when an internal process(input) convenience is called — prefer external split ownership so f.4 can share the splitter across topology. Document the chosen API.
- prepare(sampleRate, maxBlockSize, numChannels, maxBands)/reset(); realtime-safe; fixed maxBands <= 3.

Do NOT implement HissCurtain. Do NOT edit PluginProcessor or CMakeLists.txt (f.4). Do NOT write tests (f.5). Do NOT reimplement CrossoverSplitter math — include/use its header if needed.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: MultibandGate supports up to three bands with per-band target gains G_b*
MultibandGate applies separate open/close smoothing alphas from tau_open_b and tau_close_b as in spec §16
MultibandGate reconstructs output as y[n] = sum_b G_b[n] * x_b[n]
MultibandGate exposes per-band floor (0 dB to −80 dB mapping) and mute/solo controls
MultibandGate supports curve shape via gamma (or named Natural/Firm/Clamp) on the target path
No heap allocation in the per-block process path after prepare
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: accept pre-split band buffers from CrossoverSplitter rather than owning the splitter
simplify hard/soft/expander knee to target-gain + gamma if full detector law lives upstream
use plain C++20 + JUCE types already in the project
forbidden: implement HissCurtain SNR/TPT path inside MultibandGate
